WITH period_rates AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_name,
    CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 'jan_apr' ELSE 'may_oct' END AS period,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL) AS total_po,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL)::float /
      NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL),0) AS on_time_rate
  FROM v_purchasing
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'
    AND received_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY supplier_name,
    CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 'jan_apr' ELSE 'may_oct' END
),
rate_diff AS (
  SELECT
    p1.supplier_name,
    p1.on_time_rate AS rate_jan_apr,
    p2.on_time_rate AS rate_may_oct,
    (p1.on_time_rate - p2.on_time_rate) AS rate_drop
  FROM period_rates p1
  JOIN period_rates p2 ON p1.supplier_name = p2.supplier_name
  WHERE p1.period = 'jan_apr' AND p2.period = 'may_oct'
)
SELECT
  supplier_name AS supplier,
  ROUND(rate_jan_apr * 100, 2) AS rate_jan_apr_pct,
  ROUND(rate_may_oct * 100, 2) AS rate_may_oct_pct,
  ROUND(rate_drop * 100, 2) AS drop_pct
FROM rate_diff
ORDER BY drop_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(((oct.rev - sep.rev) / NULLIF(sep.rev, 0)) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM (SELECT rev FROM monthly_rev WHERE month = DATE '2026-10-01') oct,
     (SELECT rev FROM monthly_rev WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01') sep

SELECT category,
       ROUND(SUM(margin)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(revenue),0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cust_rev AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY customer_id
), total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total
  FROM cust_rev
), top10_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS top_total
  FROM (
    SELECT revenue
    FROM cust_rev
    ORDER BY revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t
)
SELECT ROUND((top10_rev.top_total / total_rev.total) * 100, 2) AS top10_rev_pct
FROM top10_rev, total_rev

SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH rev_q AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date)::date AS quarter_start,
    SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id, quarter_start
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    q2.customer_id,
    q2.rev AS rev_q2,
    q3.rev AS rev_q3
  FROM rev_q q2
  LEFT JOIN rev_q q3 ON q2.customer_id = q3.customer_id
    AND q3.quarter_start = DATE '2026-07-01'
  WHERE q2.quarter_start = DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND q2.rev > 0
    AND q3.rev IS NOT NULL
    AND q3.rev < q2.rev
) sub

SELECT category,
       ROUND(SUM(on_hand * unit_cost)::numeric, 2) AS inventory_cost
FROM v_products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY inventory_cost DESC

SELECT product_id,
       sku,
       product_name,

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) , 2) AS pct_paid
FROM v_receivables
WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

WITH customer_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_segment,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM v_sales
    WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id, customer_segment
)
SELECT 
    customer_segment AS segment,
    ROUND(AVG(total_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rev_per_customer
FROM customer_rev
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY segment

SELECT
  r.customer_id,
  r.customer_name,
  ROUND(SUM(r.balance)::numeric, 2) AS overdue_balance,
  COUNT(*) AS overdue_invoices
FROM v_receivables r
WHERE r.status = 'overdue'
GROUP BY r.customer_id, r.customer_name
ORDER BY overdue_balance DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_nov_dec,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_jul_aug
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
)
SELECT ROUND(rev_nov_dec - rev_jul_aug, 2) AS revenue_diff
FROM rev

WITH rev_q AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    CASE
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'Q2'
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' THEN 'Q3'
    END AS quarter,
    SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name, quarter
)
SELECT
  q3.product_id,
  q3.product_name,
  ROUND(q3.rev - COALESCE(q2.rev, 0), 2) AS revenue_growth
FROM rev_q q3
LEFT JOIN rev_q q2 ON q3.product_id = q2.product_id AND q2.quarter = 'Q2'
WHERE q3.quarter = 'Q3'
ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN days_late > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_late
FROM v_purchasing
WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       SUM(s.qty) AS units_sold,
       ROUND(SUM(s.margin) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM v_sales s
JOIN v_products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE s.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(s.qty) >= 100
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 3
